about: Why a connection of the IDE's vault cannot be saved (clarity_vault::connection_problems, which save_connection refuses with, and the Vault tab's connectionProblems in app/src/lib/vault.ts, which says it before saving): it needs a name, every field a name used once (ignoring case), and a field from the vault the category and key of its secret. `problems` is what is said, in order; none when it can be saved.
